# PR:10

## Intent

Update `pypdf` to resolve medium-severity Dependabot alerts:

- `ALERT:18`: inefficient FlateDecode PNG predictor decoding, fixed by `pypdf` 6.12.2.
- `ALERT:19`: large memory usage during form XObject text extraction, fixed by `pypdf` 6.12.2.
- `ALERT:20`: infinite loop in layout-mode text extraction font retrieval, fixed by `pypdf` 6.13.0.
- `ALERT:21`: infinite loop when processing outlines/bookmarks in writer, fixed by `pypdf` 6.13.0.

## Maintainer Decision

Handle through local dependency refresh instead of merging the PR. `uv` resolved `pypdf` 6.13.2, which is newer than the PR target.

## Verification

`uv lock --check` passed. `uv run pytest` passed.
